name: Building plumbing governing code
value: IPC-21 unless AHJ does not require it
applicability_context: building plumbing

name: Referenced code treatment
value: Referenced codes/standards apply to prescribed extent
applicability_context: standards hierarchy

name: Apartment fixture basis
value: 1 WC + 1 lavatory + 1 bath/shower per dwelling unit; kitchen sink per dwelling unit; clothes-washer connection 1 per 20 units
applicability_context: fixture count

name: Peak fixture outlet pressure
value: Fixture-specific; e.g. 8 psi for private lavatory/shower/residential sink and 20 psi for close-coupled tank WC
applicability_context: building distribution

name: Peak fixture outlet flow
value: Fixture-specific; e.g. private lavatory 0.8 gpm, shower 2.5 gpm, residential sink 1.75 gpm, close-coupled tank WC 3 gpm
applicability_context: building distribution

name: Booster trigger
value: Install booster where source pressure is insufficient for required fixture outlet flow pressure
applicability_context: building distribution

name: Minimum credible source pressure
value: Use minimum available pressure where source pressure fluctuates
applicability_context: building distribution

name: Pipe sizing method
value: Accepted engineering method approved by code official/AHJ; Appendix E provides procedures based on pressure, elevation, friction and fixture flow
applicability_context: building distribution

name: Hot/tempered water developed length
applicability_context: hot water distribution

name: Distribution-main velocity
applicability_context: Public water-supply distribution main; source-specific, not an automatic building-internal criterion

name: Rising-main velocity
applicability_context: Public water-supply rising main; source-specific, not an automatic building-internal criterion

name: Maximum-day factor
applicability_context: public water-supply network

name: Peak-hour factor
applicability_context: public water-supply network

applicability_context: public water-supply network

applicability_context: public water-supply network

applicability_context: public water-supply source

name: Tubewell screen entrance velocity
applicability_context: tubewell screen

name: Booster system trigger
value: Required when source pressure is insufficient to provide code-required fixture pressures and quantities
applicability_context: building water distribution

name: Booster low-pressure cutoff threshold
applicability_context: booster pump suction protection

name: Maximum building static pressure before PRV
applicability_context: building water distribution

name: Booster terminal pressure basis
value: Use the hydraulically critical fixture/outlet pressure requirement from IPC Table 604.3 or the manufacturer requirement for unlisted fixtures
applicability_context: building water distribution

name: Hot-water developed length without treating recirculation as source
applicability_context: hot-water distribution

name: Demand recirculation cold-water entry temperature limit
applicability_context: hot-water recirculation

name: Recirculation flow sizing basis
value: Qp = q/(rho cp Δt), where q is total piping heat loss and Δt is allowable temperature drop
applicability_context: hot-water recirculation

name: Recirculation pump head basis
value: Calculate loop hydraulic resistance from actual supply/return circuit; select pump for required circulation flow and required loop head from pump curve
applicability_context: hot-water recirculation
